signals.summary: Company cut its 2026 organic net sales growth outlook to 5% to 6%, and layoffs are expected.
Board approved a 2026 Restructuring Plan setting aside up to $300 million for employee termination benefits, including Costa Rica.
Boston Scientific opened an additional manufacturing plant in Cartago, Costa Rica this year.
Restructuring is projected to cut gross annual pre-tax expenses by about $500 million, reinvested into growth initiatives.
Ranked as Costa Rica's leading medical device exporter in 2024 and the first half of 2025.
